headline: Ingersoll Rand (IR) Buys Lone Star Blower To Grow Mission Critical Industrial Reach
summary: Ingersoll Rand (NYSE:IR) has agreed to acquire Lone Star Blower, Inc., expanding its presence in mission critical industrial markets. The deal adds Lone Star’s blower, compressor, and control system technologies, along with its water and wastewater footprint, to Ingersoll Rand’s Industrial Technologies and Services segment.
